# ProsperoStore catalog sample

`manifest.json`, `manifest.sig` and `index.json` were downloaded unchanged from
`https://prosperostore.net/api/v1/` on 2026-11-27 (sequence 1293). They are the
catalog's published, signed output of
[darkxex/ps5-homebrew-catalog](https://github.com/darkxex/ps5-homebrew-catalog)
(GPL-3.0) and are used here only to test signature and hash verification against
the real signing scheme. App names and descriptions belong to their developers.
